notes: Match to a reference (experimental): pick one hit and the plug-in looks through your library for the samples whose sum sounds like it, and puts the answer into the mixer. Choose the drum (Kick / Snare / Tom), the range, the most samples, the time limit, and optionally Tune; a library cache makes the search start at once. The search goes on in the background even if you close the window; Stop keeps the answers found so far, and the window shows the time it took. It works with a licence key, not in the 14-day trial. Details in the manual.
